retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist composition featuring a central figure suspended in air above a radial arrangement of objects on water against a high-contrast sunset sky.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tiered vertical composition: a vibrant orange-to-purple sunset sky with a man in mid-air, a dark city silhouette on the horizon, and a deep blue ocean surface featuring a circular array of guitars and equipment.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical tension between the floating figure and the water surface
Radial symmetry of objects on the water pointing toward a central axis
Color contrast between the warm sky and the cool blue water
Horizon line acting as a divider for the central typographic placement
coreInvariants: The figure must be in a dynamic, horizontal floating pose
The horizon line must be positioned at the vertical center
Objects on the water must be arranged in a sunburst or radial pattern

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A male figure occupies the upper third, scaled to appear distant yet central; a radial collection of objects dominates the lower half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central guitar at the bottom foreground and the floating figure at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the floating figure, drop to the central text on the horizon, and then spiral outward through the radial objects on the water.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky in the top corners and open water in the bottom corners provide breathing room for the complex central elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue water (base) and vibrant orange sky (top).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark silhouette of the city and shadows on the water.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for typography and highlights on the floating hat.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky and water; high value contrast between the white text and the dark horizon.

letterConstructionRules: Square proportions with slightly rounded corners
Wide tracking for readability across the horizon
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface with weight or opacity variation between primary and secondary words.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric clarity and modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal landscape with a vibrant orange and purple sunset sky. In the sky, a man in jeans and a t-shirt is floating horizontally. Below him is a dark city skyline on the horizon. The bottom half is a deep blue ocean with a radial arrangement of guitars, microphones, and fishing gear floating on the surface.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered uppercase geometric sans-serif text across the horizon line in white, using wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered on the horizon?
Is the sky a gradient of orange to purple?
Are the objects on the water arranged radially?
Is the figure floating in the upper half?

adjustableVariables: Density of objects on the water
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand logos on the guitars
Ensure the city silhouette is generic

mustAchieve: Seamless compositing of the figure and objects
Clear, legible typography against the dark horizon
avoid: Mismatched lighting between the figure and the environment

postGenerationChecks: Verify the horizon line is perfectly horizontal
Ensure the text tracking is consistent
Confirm the color transition in the sky is smooth
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Composite = (Dynamic Floating Subject + Radial Object Array) / (High-Contrast Bipartite Horizon Layout) + Wide-Tracked Geometric Sans-Serif
